name: Karl Hoffmann
qualifications: BA, LLB, Conveyancer, Mediation Foundation Training
bio: Karl holds a Bachelor of Arts and a Bachelor of Laws from Rhodes University, and is an admitted attorney and conveyancer of the High Court of South Africa.

He joined HSG in 2014 and is a director and head of the conveyancing department. His work is largely project-related conveyancing in the public and private sectors: he has acted as the appointed conveyancer for low-income government housing developments, private gated estates, and sectional-title conversions and developments, and has handled timeshare conveyancing for a national leisure group across South Africa. His particular areas are land assembly through consolidation and subdivision, the opening of township registers, and sectional-title establishment and transfer.
Karl has also completed training in mediation, co-mediation and alternative dispute resolution, which he uses to resolve disputes without protracted litigation.
